title: A Notice to Xbox 360 Version Users
body:
Typically, many users of the Xbox 360 version of FINAL FANTASY XI will shut down the game via the "Xbox Guide Button" located on the controller. However, we have confirmed an issue where if you attempt to shut down via the "Xbox Guide Button" while the PlayOnline Viewer and/or FINAL FANTASY XI is running, it may cause the Xbox 360 to not be able to properly read the disc.

Until this issue is addressed, we ask that you shut down the PlayOnline Viewer through the "Exit Viewer" option and FINAL FANTASY XI through the "Shut Down" option in-game.

For users who are experiencing the issue, please contact Xbox Support for assistance.

title: All Worlds Maintenance (Nov. 9)
body:
At the following time, we will be performing maintenance on all FINAL FANTASY XI worlds to accompany the version update and the implementation of "A Shantotto Ascension - The Legend Torn, Her Empire Born," the third and the final in a series of three add-on scenarios for FINAL FANTASY XI. During this period, FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable.

Thank you for your patience and understanding in this matter.

* This maintenance will be accompanied by a version update. After maintenance is complete, the update will automatically begin after you press the "Play" button. After that, please follow the instructions on the screen.

* The World Transfer Service will be unavailable starting 30 minutes before the maintenance. Please wait until after the maintenance is completed before attempting to use this service.

* You may receive errors such as "POL-1160" or "POL-0010" during the download process due to heavy server traffic. If you are unable to access the update, we ask that you please wait a while and then try again.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding in making this a smooth version update.

* New add-on scenario "A Shantotto Ascension - The Legend Torn, Her Empire Born" will be become playable after the version update. For those who have already purchased the add-on scenario, please confirm whether the title of the add-on scenario is present on the FINAL FANTASY XI title screen after the version update is complete.

* For the update details, please refer to "Topics" on the official PlayOnline.com web site or PlayOnline Viewer which will be available on Monday, Nov. 9, 2009.

[Date & Time]
Nov. 9, 2009 from 8:00 to 12:30 (PST)
* Maintenance completion time may be subject to change.

[Affected Services]
FINAL FANTASY XI

title: Announcing the World Merge
body:
To allow players to enjoy all the content the game has to offer, we will be performing a World Merge.

Please refer to the "Guidance on the World Merge" for more details.


[Guidance on the World Merge]

- Schedule
World Merge will be performed during the upcoming version update. Once the version update is complete, characters from the "Source Worlds" will be migrated automatically to the "Destination Worlds".

* The schedule for the version update will be released at a later date.


- Details on the World Merge
The following is a list of worlds designated for the World Merge.
  Source World     Destination World

  Fairy    -> Sylph
  Kujata    -> Valefor
  Remora    -> Leviathan
  Midgardsormr -> Quetzalcoatl
  Hades    -> Cerberus
  Seraph    -> Bismarck
  Garuda    -> Lakshmi
  Pandemonium -> Asura

* Other worlds will not be affected.


- Things to note for the World Merge
Character Data:
Other than the data listed below, all character data will be transferred to the new world. This includes character status, belongings, gil and key items.

Character Name:
In cases where a character with the same name already exists on the "Destination World," you may be required to change the name of your character. If this is necessary, your character name on the character selection screen before login will be displayed in yellow. Follow the onscreen instructions to complete the change.

Changing the character name will not affect data such as your Friends List.

Items stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House:
Items and gil stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House will be deleted automatically when the World Merge takes place. Please move them to your character's belongings or Mog Safe before the World Merge.

Please note that items and gil lost in the merge cannot be restored through the Item Restoration service.

Linkshell, Pearlsack and Linkpearl:
Pearlsacks and Linkpearls cannot be carried over to the "Destination World," and will disappear during the World Merge. Linkshell owners will receive an unopened Linkshell when they log into the "Destination World" for the first time. Unopened Linkshells will not be affected by the merge.

Please note that you will need to create a new Linkshell Community after creating a new linkshell on the "Destination World."


- Suspension of the World Transfer Service
The World Transfer service will be suspended from Mar. 9, 2010 7:00 PST until the World Merge is complete.


- Suspension of the Character Reactivation Service
The Character Reactivation Service will be suspended from Mar. 9, 2010 7:00 PST until the World Merge is complete.


- Regarding the worlds Odin and Bahamut
After the World Merge is complete, the following services will be reinstated:

Character transfers to Odin/Bahamut.
Creating a new character on Odin/Bahamut.
Issuing a Gold World Pass on Odin/Bahamut.

*Due to the phrase that may cause misunderstanding, this announcement was corrected on Mar. 1, 2010 4:00 PST.

*Due to the schedule on suspension of the Character Reactivation Service being incorrect, this announcement was updated on Mar. 2, 2010 22:15 PST.

title: Temporary Suspension of North American GM Petition Service
body:
At the following time, the North American GM petition service for FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable due to network maintenance.

The North American GMs will not be able to answer calls during this time. For urgent issues, the European GM petition service will be operating as normal and users may still place GM calls. However, please be aware that there may be some delays until the GM calls are answered.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation in this matter.

Mar. 3, 2010 from 19:00 to 20:30 (PST)

North American GM petition service for FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable

title: All Worlds Maintenance (Mar. 22)
body:
At the following time, we will be performing FINAL FANTASY XI maintenance on all worlds to accompany the version update and implementation of a World Merge. Along with this maintenance, we will also be performing maintenance on the FINAL FANTASY XI Linkshell Community beta version.

During this period, both FINAL FANTASY XI and the FINAL FANTASY XI Linkshell Community beta version will be unavailable.

Thank you for your patience and understanding in this matter.

* This maintenance will be accompanied by a version update. After maintenance is complete, the update will automatically begin after you press the "Play" button. After that, please follow the instructions on the screen.

* You may receive errors such as "POL-1160" or "POL-0010" during the download process due to heavy server traffic. If you are unable to access the update, we ask that you please wait a while and then try again.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding in making this a smooth version update.

* During this maintenance, a World Merge will be implemented.

Source World     Destination World

  Fairy    -> Sylph
  Kujata    -> Valefor
  Remora    -> Leviathan
  Midgardsormr -> Quetzalcoatl
  Hades    -> Cerberus
  Seraph    -> Bismarck
  Garuda    -> Lakshmi
  Pandemonium -> Asura

We ask that all players on any source world retrieve all items stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House.

For more details regarding the World Merge, please refer to "Announcing the World Merge" in the Information section.

* the World Transfer Service, which is currently suspended, will reinstate service after the completion of registration server maintenance, which is scheduled to take place following the FINAL FANTASY XI maintenance. For more details, please refer to "Registration Server Maintenance (Mar. 22)."

* The schedule for the reinstatement of the Character Reactivation Service, which is currently suspended, will be announced at another time.

* Update details will be available on Mar. 22, 2010.

[Date & Time]
Mar. 22, 2010 from 8:00 to 20:00 (PDT)
* Maintenance completion time may be subject to change.

[Affected Services]
FINAL FANTASY XI

title: Current Known Issues (Mar. 25)
body:
As of Mar. 25, 2010, we have confirmed the following issues. Investigation and recovery work is currently underway. We ask for your patience in this matter until these issues have been resolved.

[Current Known Issues]
- During the mission "Project: Shantottofication," avatar and pet power cannot be enhanced inside the battlefield.

- The movement speed of Notorious Monster "Cactrot Rapido" is too slow.

* These issues were resolved as of the version update performed on Mar. 29, 2010 at 12:00 (PDT).

- Large fish that have both size and weight listed in the description cannot currently be used as ingredients for synergy.


Additional information on the latest version update follows. We are planning to make following adjustments based on a game balance perspective.

- To summon the newly added avatars "Alexander" and "Odin," the level of the Summoner must be at least 75.

- Among the new synergy recipes, items required for recipes related to the Beastmaster job ability "Call Beast" are planned to be adjusted.

* The recipes have been adjusted as of the version update performed on Mar. 29, 2010 at 12:00 (PDT).

title: Billing Reminder to PlayOnline Users
body:
Thank you for your continued use of the PlayOnline service.

This is a reminder that registration server maintenance will be held in the near future. This coincides with the normal monthly billing cycle.

Please be advised that you will not be able to perform any of the following actions during this time:
- Register or unsubscribe PlayOnline accounts
- Review or update member information
- Review, purchase, cancel, or reactivate Content IDs
- Purchase expansion pack registration codes
- Apply for World Transfer Service
- Access PlayOnline Membership Information from the official PlayOnline web site (http://www.playonline.com/)

Also, please ensure you have canceled any services you no longer wish to be charged for in advance.

You may also be disconnected from PlayOnline services during the maintenance if there is a problem with your payment method. To avoid this, please complete all necessary billing changes in advance.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

title: Temporary Suspension of North American GM Petition Service
body:
At the following time, the North American GM petition service for FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable due to a scheduled power outage.

The North American GM team will be unable to answer calls during this time. The European GM petition service will be operating as normal and users may still place GM calls for urgent issues. However, please be aware that there may be significant delays until these GM calls can be answered.

Please also be aware that non-urgent issues may be issued an automated response. Please feel free to resubmit these calls after Mar. 28, 2010 10:00 (PDT) if you feel it requires live support

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation in this matter.

title: Temporary Suspension of North American GM Petition Service
body:
At the following time, the North American GM petition service for FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable due to emergency building maintenance.

The North American GM team will be unable to answer calls during this time. The European GM petition service will be operating as normal and users may still place GM calls for urgent issues. However, please be aware that there may be significant delays until these GM calls can be answered.

Please also be aware that non-urgent issues may be issued an automated help desk response. Please feel free to resubmit these calls after Apr. 9, 2010 14:00 (PDT) if you feel it requires live support.

We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your cooperation in this matter.

[Date & Time]
Apr. 9, 2010 from 13:00 to 14:00 (PDT)

Emergency building maintenance

[Affected Services]

title: Important Notice Regarding your PlayOnline ID(s)
body:
Thank you for your continued support of PlayOnline and FINAL FANTASY XI.

As a result of an attack on our computer network, there is a possibility that information pertaining to some users has been compromised including the PlayOnline ID, PlayOnline password and certain other details obtained during registration. We have taken measures as soon as the attack was detected, and have limited the potential breach of information.

If you have linked your PlayOnline ID to a Square Enix Account, your account will be safe due to the nature of the information possibly breached. Please be assured that sensitive information such as your credit card number has not been compromised.

To prevent any misuse from accounts potentially compromised during this incident, we have changed the PlayOnline password for all those affected. We will be sending the new PlayOnline password to you by regular mail to the address registered in our records. We apologize for the inconvenience, but you will be able to login to PlayOnline using this new password. We have also sent out details on how to reset your password through our Information Center to those with a valid e-mail address, during the early hours of June 4th.

Those who can still login to PlayOnline using their current password are unaffected by the contents of this e-mail.

Please note: Square Enix employees will not ask you for your PlayOnline password regarding this incident. Please remain vigilant of any phishing attempts disguised as correspondence from Square Enix.

Thank you for your understanding, and we again apologize for any inconvenience caused.

title: About Support for Extended Validation SSL Certificates
body:
We are happy to announce that a number of SQUARE ENIX official websites now support Extended Validation (EV) SSL Certificates.

When visiting sites using the EV SSL Certificate, the address bar of supported browsers will turn green and the name of organization managing the site will be displayed, in this case "SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD." This can help you confirm that you are using an authorized SQUARE ENIX site when entering membership information.
* Information regarding EV SSL certificates, supported browsers, and settings can be found on the following site.
VeriSign, Inc. (http://www.verisign.com/ssl/ssl-information-center/ev-ssl-certificate/index.html)

title: Warning Regarding PlayOnline ID and Password Fraud
body:
It has come to our attention that certain individuals are referring players to fake FINAL FANTASY XI websites resembling the log-in page of Membership Information in an attempt to steal (also known as "phishing") the PlayOnline ID and password.

We have also confirmed the case where they try to redirect users to suspicious website by sending an URL inside the game with a message saying that user agreement violation or billing issue has been confirmed. Please note that Square Enix representative (Game Master (GM) staff included) will never ask players to log into an external website within the game.

If you experience such a request while in-game, please report the matter to a GM immediately.

Keep your data safe! Keep the PlayOnline ID and password secure!

body:

[Important Update Details]
- An issue wherein the item "Charis Tiara" would not appear on the list of tradable items when speaking to the NPC "Cruor Prospector" has been addressed.

- An issue wherein a player may be unable to complete the quest "Face of the Future" under a certain condition has been addressed.

- An issue wherein a player may be unable to progress with the quest "I Dream of Flowers" due to the item "Lilac" not disappearing from the player's inventory has been addressed.

- An issue wherein a player would not be able use the item "Jester Hat" through their inventory has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the animation of the item Jester Hat is not properly displayed when the item is used has been addressed.

- An issue wherein multiple skillchain logs will appear when the blue magic spell Benthic Typhoon is used in a skillchain has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the help text for the following items is not displayed properly has been addressed.
Taru Tot Toyset / Guild Flyers / Orblight / Raid. Bonnet +2 / Raid. Culottes +2 / Raid. Poulaines +2

- An issue wherein the party is considered to be wiped out and is forced to leave the Walk of Echoes even when players have yet to be defeated has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the weapon used in the quest to obtain weapon skills for mythic weapons has the effect of "Aftermath" has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the display format used in the messages shown when a player gains a level or merit point while in Abyssea differs from the format used in other areas has been addressed.

- An issue wherein incorrect information is displayed in the logs when the blue magic spell Final Sting is used against Martello has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the waiting period for martello core to reuse pulse martello is not shortened properly has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the quests Refuel and Replenish (***)" and "A Mightier Martello (***)" continue to appear in the current quest list even after completing the quest in question has been addressed.

- An issue wherein the quests "Refuel and Replenish (***)" and "A Mightier Martello (***)" can be canceled after being accepted, by cancelling out of the conversation with the NPC has been addressed.

title: Errors during the Version Update for "PlayStation 2"
body:
We have received some reports about the error POL-0010 which may be displayed during the version update for FINAL FANTASY XI PlayStation 2 version.

We are currently investigating this issue, but should you experience it for yourself, please try and change your MTU value settings. This may help address the issue.

*How to change your MTU value settings
1. On the page prior to the PlayOnline Viewer login page, select Network Setting, To List. Choose the option you are using, then select Change settings, 3. Auxiliary Settings then MTU value settings.
2. If you are using ISDN, select Medium. If you use ADSL or faster internet access, select Normal (recommended).

If changing MTU value settings doesnt address the issue, please wait for further announcements.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

title: Regarding the Handling of Accounts and Passwords
body:
This is an important notice regarding usage of PlayOnline IDs, Square Enix accounts, and passwords. We would like to ask that you please take the following precautions to avoid losing or letting a third party get hold of your account information.

* Do not use passwords consisting of repeating characters, your telephone number, your birthday, or anything else that might be guessed.
* Change your password regularly.
* Do not use the same password that you use for other online services. (Any single service being compromised could lead to others being compromised as well)
* Do not use any programs that might load malware onto your computer.
* Do not open any suspicious emails or files and avoid accessing any suspicious web sites.

Using a security token with your Square Enix account will dramatically increase your defense against unauthorized access and we highly recommend their use for any customers not already using them.

To learn more about security tokens, please visit the following page:
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Thank you for your cooperation in helping us protect your personal information and data.

title: A Reminder About Password Security (Dec. 2)
body:
Recently, a small number of customers outside of North America have reported that their accounts were compromised. Upon investigation, we found that many of these users used the same name and password for their Square Enix Account as for another companys online service which recently experienced a data breach.  Knowing that many users use the same name and password for multiple services, it appears an unknown third party was able to gain unauthorized access to some Square Enix Accounts.

Accordingly, we advise that you take extra precautions to protect your Square Enix Account. In order to maximize security, we would like to remind you of these good practices:

* Do not use the same password for multiple online services
* Do not use repeated strings of characters, phone numbers, birth dates, or other similar information in your password
* Change your password regularly
* Do not use programs that put you at risk of malware
* Do not open emails or files when you do not know who sent them, and
* Do not access suspicious websites

By using a Square Enix Security Token with your Square Enix Account, you can greatly decrease the likelihood that your account will be compromised. We strongly recommend that you begin using one if you are not already doing so.

See the below URL for more information about Security Tokens.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

title: A Reminder About Password Security: Follow-up
body:
This is an update to our recent announcement regarding password security made on December 2, 2010.

In that announcement, we stated that certain users outside of North America had their Square Enix Accounts compromised as a result of using the same name and password for their Square Enix Account as for another companys online service which recently experienced a data breach. 

We have now discovered that this issue was not confined to Japan, and some users in North America have also reported unauthorized access to some Square Enix Accounts.

We wish to assure our customers that their financial information is not at risk should an account be compromised since Square Enix takes extra precautions to safeguard such information.

Nevertheless, we strongly advise our customers to review the notice posted on December 2, 2010 and follow these extra precautions to ensure the security of your Square Enix Account.

title: Regarding an Issue Affecting PlayStation 2 Ver.: Follow-up 2
body:
We would like to provide an update regarding the issue where players are unable to complete the version update and receive a message stating that there is not enough free space on the PlayStation BB Unit.

We have determined that the version update is being performed, but in some cases unnecessary files are being saved to the hard disk. These files might accumulate and take up hard disk space, thus preventing the version update from being completed.

Deleting these unnecessary files will allow you to perform the version update, but in order to delete them you must first perform a clean installation of FINAL FANTASY XI.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but if you are experiencing the issue described above, we ask that you please perform a clean installation of FINAL FANTASY XI.

Please note that we are planning on implementing a method for version updates to be performed even when there is little space available on hard drives.
* Even after the implementation of this system, a clean installation will be required to remove unnecessary files.

* The feature mentioned above was implemented with the version update made on Feb. 14, 2011 at 9:30 a.m. (PST).

[How to Perform a Clean Installation]
1. Start the PlayOnline Viewer
2. Insert the PlayOnline/FINAL FANTASY XI disc into the Playstation 2 3. Select "Install" from the left menu of the PlayOnline login screen 4. Select FINAL FANTASY XI as the software that you wish to install 5. Once the FINAL FANTASY XI screen is displayed, select "Start Installation"

6. Once the following message is displayed, select "Yes"

FINAL FANTASY XI is already installed.
Reinstalling this disc will overwrite all existing FINAL FANTASY XI files.
Your character data will not be lost.
However, before you can play, you will have to download all the updates from the PlayOnline servers again.
Begin reinstallation?

7. Once the following message is displayed, select "No"

Preserve user settings file?
Select "Yes" to reinstall with customized settings such as macros and marker data left intact.
select "No" to perform a clean installation that restores default settings.
A clean installation is recommended if you are having problems with the program data.

8. Clean installation will now begin

title: Caution Concerning Use of "Moogle Storage Slip"
body:
Recently, players have contacted us concerning an issue where storing an item with a Porter Moogle NPC while Trial of the Magians was in progress prevented further progress in the trial.

As noted in the FINAL FANTASY XI Version Update (Dec. 6), storing an item with a Porter Moogle NPC while Trial of the Magians is in progress will result in all trial insignias being erased from that item, requiring cancellation and restarting of the trial. Furthermore all items placed in the Delivery Crate up to that point will be lost.

Any items required for quest completion lost in this way cannot be restored by GM support, so we ask that you please take sufficient caution when using a "Moogle Storage Slip."

We are currently working on implementing changes to prevent such incidences from occurring in the next version update. Once the updates are implemented, players should no longer be able to store items with trial insignias using the "Moogle Storage Slip."

* After the version update on Feb. 14, 2011, items involved in ongoing Magian trials can no longer be stored using the porter service.

title: Announcement for Square Enix Account Users
body:
As a measure to help prevent unauthorized access to Square Enix accounts, we will be introducing a system to restrict logins when suspicious account access is detected.

This system will be implemented for FINAL FANTASY XIV during the maintenance on on February 21st, 2011, with implementation for PlayOnline and FINAL FANTASY XI following shortly thereafter. Details on the maintenance will be announced at a later time.

Customers with accounts for FINAL FANTASY XIV and FINAL FANTASY XI linked to the same Square Enix account will have access to both games restricted and receive a Unauthorized connection to server detected message when trying to access PlayOnline in the event that their FINAL FANTASY XIV login is restricted. Square Enix accounts that use security tokens, however, will never have their logins restricted.

Under this new system, once login has been restricted, an email notification will be sent to the primary email address registered to the Square Enix Account. This email will contain instructions on how to remove the login restriction. Players will be asked to reset their passwords and log in again.

If you are unable to receive the email instructions for removing the login restriction, you will be unable to log in to your account, so please make sure that you have registered a valid email address by February 21st, 2011.

SQUARE ENIX Account Management System
https://secure.square-enix.com/

If you have any questions about how to remove login restrictions, or have accidentally deleted the email instructions, and are unable to resolve the situation on your own, please refer to the link below.

About Login Restriction
http://support.na.square-enix.com/j/lbna

We cannot guarantee that these security measures will be enough to completely eliminate unauthorized access to accounts, and we ask for your cooperation in protecting your personal information, and in taking appropriate security precautions when using your account.

title: Announcing the World Merge
body:
To allow players to enjoy all the content the game has to offer, we will be performing a World Merge.

Please refer to the "Guidance on the World Merge" below for more details.

[Guidance on the World Merge]

- Schedule
World Merge will be performed during the upcoming maintenance scheduled for Mar. 16, 2011. Once the maintenance is complete, characters from the "Source Worlds" will be migrated automatically to the "Destination Worlds."

* The schedule for the maintenace will be released at a later date.

- Details on the World Merge
The following is a list of Worlds designated for the World Merge.

  Source World -> Destination World

  Ramuh -> Bahamut
  Alexander -> Shiva
  Titan -> Phoenix
  Gilgamesh -> Carbuncle
  Unicorn -> Fenrir
  Ifrit -> Odin
  Diabolos -> Siren
  Caitsith -> Ragnarok

* Other Worlds will not be affected.


- Things to note for the World Merge

Character Data:
Other than the data listed below, all character data will be transferred to the new World. This includes character status, items held by the player character, items stored in Mog safes, banks, and the like, items held by NPCs, gil, and key items.

Character Name:
In cases where a character with the same name already exists on the "Destination World," you may be required to change the name of your character. If this is necessary, your character name on the character selection screen before login will be displayed in yellow. Follow the onscreen instructions to complete the change.

Changing the character name will not affect data such as your Friends List.

Items stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House:
Items and gil stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House will be deleted automatically when the World Merge takes place. Please move them to your character's belongings or Mog Safe before the World Merge.

Please note that items and gil lost in the merge cannot be restored through the Item Restoration service.

Added Mar. 2, 2011 at 22:10 (PST):
* Items and gil will only be deleted on the "Source World." There will be no impact on the "Destination World."

Linkshell, Pearlsack and Linkpearl:
Pearlsacks and Linkpearls cannot be carried over to the "Destination World," and will disappear during the World Merge. Linkshell owners will receive an unopened Linkshell when they log into the "Destination World" for the first time. Unopened Linkshells will not be affected by the merge.

Please note that you will need to create a new Linkshell Community after creating a new linkshell on the "Destination World."

- Suspension of the World Transfer Service The World Transfer service will be suspended from Mar. 7, 2011 7:00 a.m. PST until the World Merge is complete.

title: Important Announcement Regarding the Recent Events in Japan
body:
To the SQUARE ENIX community:

As you know, Japan has been hit with a terrible disaster this week.  We have received and greatly appreciate all the kind words of concern from our fans and players.

As a result of the earthquake, we temporarily may have to shut down the servers hosting FINAL FANTASY XI and FINAL FANTASY XIV.

We are now analyzing the situation and studying very hard what we can do to fulfill our social responsibilities under the unusual circumstances, and to mitigate the inconvenience to our players.  According to our best estimate at this point, we will temporarily have to shut down the servers shortly.  We will give you as much advance notice as possible under the rapidly changing circumstances.  If the servers are shut down, we will try to provide updates in the Information section of our Official Website below.

FINAL FANTASY XIV , The Lodestone: http://lodestone.finalfantasyxiv.com/
FINAL FANTASY XI Official Website: http://www.playonline.com/

We sincerely apologize and appreciate your understanding.

Sincerely,
SQUARE ENIX

title: Temporary Suspension of the Services Due to an Earthquake
body:
Due to the continuous earthquakes occurring in the eastern regions of Japan since Mar. 11, 2011, the power companies in Japan have encouraged everyone to cooperate by conserving as much energy as possible as it is feared there will not be enough power supply. Based on the current situation, we have decided to shut down the game servers temporarily, and therefore to suspend services of FINAL FANTASY XIV, FINAL FANTASY XI, and PlayOnline temporarily.

The services will be temporarily suspended for at least a week starting on Mar. 13, 2011 3:00 (PDT). We will provide an update regarding the reinstatement of the service as additional information becomes available. In connection with the temporary suspension of services, players will not be billed for any PlayOnline service throughout the April billing cycle. Additional information regarding this matter will also be posted as it becomes available.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and thank you for your understanding of this unusual situations.

[Date & Time]
A week starting from Mar. 13, 2011 3:00 (PDT)

[Affected Service]
- FINAL FANTASY XIV
- FINAL FANTASY XI
- PlayOnline

* The following services, normally accessible from the official PlayOnline homepage (http://www.playonline.com/), will be unavailable during this time.

- Friend List Plus
- FINAL FANTASY XI Linkshell Community Beta Version
- PlayOnline Friend List Application
- Community Site Link Registration: Owner Menu

* Additionally, the following types of support will also be temporarily unavailable:
- PlayOnline Password Recovery
- PlayOnline Account Cancellation
- All activities requiring the confirmation of personal information

* Please be advised that we will continue to operate the official websites, FINAL FANTASY XIV Lodestone, forums, and the SQUARE ENIX Support Center to be able provide our customers with updates on the current situation.

[Reference]
An excerpt from the Caution posted on
TOKYO ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY (TEPCO)s home page:

A big earthquake occurred in the northern part of Japan at 2:46PM of March 11th 2011. Because TEPCO's facilities have been seriously damaged, power shortage may occur.
TEPCO appreciates customers' cooperation in reducing electricity usage by avoiding using unnecessary lighting and electrical equipment.
We are taking all measures to restore power, however, we expect extremely challenging situation in power supply for a while. We kindly ask our customers to cooperate with us in reducing usage of power.

title: Restoration of Game Services (Mar. 22)
body:
As part of power conservation measures enacted following the Tohoku earthquake, our game servers were shut down on Mar. 13, 2011 3:00 (PDT) and services for FINAL FANTASY XIV, FINAL FANTASY XI, and PlayOnline (hereafter referred to as "these services") were temporarily suspended. We have determined a date for the restoration of these services, and would like to share this information with you.

Operating the servers for these services makes up 11.6% of the total power consumed by our Tokyo office (based on February 2011 records). We have shut down our air conditioning system (8.8%) and enacted other power conservation measures, such as reducing lighting in our offices, to achieve over 10% in energy usage reductions. With these energy saving measures in place, we will be able to bring our servers back online and restore service to FINAL FANTASY XIV, FINAL FANTASY XI, and PlayOnline on Mar. 25, 2011 4:00 (PDT). All other services, such as those offered on the PlayOnline website, that were temporarily suspended will also be restored at the same time. Please be aware, however, that we may once again be required to suspend services in the event that the power situation worsens.

We offer our sincere apologies for the inconvenience caused by the temporary suspension of these services, and thank you for your understanding. As noted in our original notice regarding the suspension of these services, customers will not be charged any monthly fees for FINAL FANTASY XI throughout the April billing cycle.

We at the Square Enix group are trying to act in a proactive manner in order to provide support towards the relief and restoration efforts in the face of this unprecedented disaster while providing reliable service to our customers, and we thank you for your understanding and support.

body:
Due to the temporary suspension of the FINAL FANTASY XI game service, customers with active, paying subscriptions as of March 2011 will not be charged monthly FINAL FANTASY XI subscription fees ($12.95 + $1.00 per additional Content ID) for the April billing cycle. Below is a list of important notices for affected customers.

[Important Notes]
* Only customers who paid subscription fees for March 2011 are eligible. Customers registering new accounts or reactivating accounts in April are not eligible.
* Fees for any additional Content IDs purchased from April 1, 2011 onwards will not be waived.
* Any charges aside from monthly subscription and additional Content ID fees (e.g., expansion purchases, etc.) will not be waived.
* Customers who closed their accounts during March will be eligible. However, you must reactivate your account before the end of April; since subscription fees are only being waived for the month of April, we recommend you reactivate early in order to reap the full benefits of this offer.

  Caitsith -> Ragnarok

* Other Worlds will not be affected.

- Things to note for the World Merge

Character Data:
Other than the data listed below, all character data will be transferred to the new World. This includes character status, items held by the character, items stored in Mog safes, banks, and the like, as well as items held by NPCs, gil, and key items.

Character Name:
In cases where a character with the same name already exists on the "Destination World," you may be required to change the name of your character. If this is necessary, your character name on the character selection screen before login will be displayed in yellow. Follow the onscreen instructions to complete the change.

Changing the character name will not affect data such as your Friends List.

Items stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House:
Items and gil stored in the Delivery Box or Auction House will be deleted automatically when the World Merge takes place. Please move them to your character's belongings or Mog Safe before the World Merge.

Please note that items and gil lost in the merge cannot be restored through the Item Restoration service.

* Items and gil will only be deleted on the "Source World." There will be no impact on the "Destination World."

Linkshell, Pearlsack and Linkpearl:
Pearlsacks and linkpearls cannot be carried over to the "Destination World," and will disappear during the World Merge. Linkshell owners will receive an unopened linkshell when they log into the "Destination World" for the first time. Unopened linkshells will not be affected by the merge.

Please note that you will need to create a new linkshell community after creating a new linkshell on the "Destination World."

- Suspension of the World Transfer Service
The World Transfer service was suspended as of Mar. 7, 2011 7:00 (PDT). It will resume once the World Merge is complete.

- Suspension of Character Creation
As of Mar. 2, 2011 5:00 (PDT), the following functions were disabled on Source Worlds and Destination Worlds. Once World Merge is complete they will be restored.
* Creation of new characters on the affected worlds
* Use of Gold World Passes on the affected worlds

-  Suspension of Character Reactivation Service
The character reactivation service was suspended as of Mar. 7, 2011 7:00 (PDT). Because it will take additional time to merge the character data from the Source Worlds and Destination Worlds, this service will not be immediately available following completion of the World Merge. Once a recovery date is determined we will make an announcement.

title: A Reminder About Password Security
body:
This is an important reminder for customers with either PlayOnline accounts or Square Enix Accounts.

In the event that another company's online service experiences a data breach, use of the same name and password across multiple services could lead to an unknown third party gaining unauthorized access to your accounts.

Accordingly, we advise that you take extra precautions to protect your Square Enix Account. In order to maximize security, we would like to remind you of the following password management practices:

* Do not use the same password for multiple online services
* Do not use repeated strings of characters, phone numbers, birth dates, or other similar information in your password
* Change your password regularly
* Do not use programs that put you at risk of malware
* Do not open emails or files when you do not know who sent them, and
* Do not access suspicious websites

By using a Square Enix Security Token with your Square Enix Account, you can greatly decrease the likelihood that your account will be compromised. We strongly recommend that you begin using one if you are not already doing so.

See the below URL for more information about Security Tokens.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Customers with accounts for FINAL FANTASY XIV and FINAL FANTASY XI linked to the same Square Enix account will have access to both games restricted and receive a Unauthorized connection to server detected message when trying to access PlayOnline in the event that their FINAL FANTASY XIV login is restricted. Square Enix accounts that use security tokens, however, will never have their logins restricted.

Under this new system, once login has been restricted, an email notification will be sent to the primary email address registered to the Square Enix Account. This email will contain instructions on how to remove the login restriction. Players will be asked to reset their passwords and log in again.

About Login Restriction
http://support.na.square-enix.com/j/lbna

Thank you for your cooperation in helping us protect your personal information and data.

title: Square Enix Account Transfer
body:
In order to better safeguard the account security of PlayOnline users and to provide a more streamlined account management experience, we will be transferring all PlayOnline IDs to the Square Enix Account system.

The transfer process will be available in the last half of July, and will give users access to an improved user interface that will allow account management from any web-browser.

Please visit the following link for details on all of these changes.


Please note that all users will have to log in and agree to the transfer by mid fall 2011 (deadline to be announced)*, or they will lose access to PlayOnline and FINAL FANTASY XI until the transfer process is completed.
*Note: We have extended the transfer cut-off date from the original deadline of August 31 in order to implement payment option improvements. Please visit here for more details.

A walkthrough detailing the transfer process has been posted on the PlayOnline website here.

This transfer will require you have a Square Enix Account. If you dont already have a Square Enix Account, we strongly encourage you to create one in advance here. Customers who already have Square Enix Accounts need only complete the transfer process.

We hope youll agree that this marks a significant step towards providing a more secure, user-friendly, and responsive experience.

title: Linking Character Data to Forum Profiles
body:
We would like to announce a new function enabling players to link character data to their forum profiles. This feature will go live as part of the FINAL FANTASY XI Forum maintenance scheduled for June 28, 2011.

At present, players are required to use a Square Enix ID when logging into the forums. Characters on the PlayOnline ID associated with this Square Enix ID will now be displayed in forum profiles. Players with more than one character registered to their account may select which character to link.

After logging into the forums following the maintenance, players will be taken to the Profile Settings screen and asked to choose an active character. Forum posts cannot be made until a character has been selected.

Forum profiles will now display the following:
- Character name
- World name
- Up to three jobs and levels of a player's choosing
* The above information cannot be hidden.

Players will retain forum handles.

title: Square Enix Account Transfer: Follow-up
body:
In order to improve the quality of our services, we will be transferring all PlayOnline accounts to Square Enix Accounts. 

Transfer Period
July 27th, 2011 (Wed) to Mid Fall 2011 (To Be Determined)
*Note: We have extended the transfer cut-off date from the original deadline of August 31 in order to implement payment option improvements. Please visit here for more details.

Transfer Process
In the interests of account security, we ask that all users take action to complete the account transfer process. You can perform the transfer easily by following the instructions on the Account Transfer Page that will be shared on July 27, 2011. This page will detail the transfer process for those users who have a Square Enix ID and those who still need to create a Square Enix ID.
Please note that a Square Enix ID is REQUIRED to complete the transfer process. To help simplify this process, we strongly suggest that all users complete the Square Enix account creation process and obtain a Square Enix ID prior to the transfer start date. If you need to create a Square Enix ID, please visit this link.

A PlayOnline ID and password will be required for PlayOnline accounts in order to complete the transfer process. If you need to recover your PlayOnline ID or password, please visit here.

Additional Information
Special In-Game Bonus
Users who complete the transfer process prior to August 31, 2011 will be rewarded with a special in-game item for FINAL FANTASY XI. Additional details are available here.

Subscription Periods
As a result of the transfer to the Square Enix Account Management system, the subscription period for Final Fantasy XI will be changed from $12.95/month to $12.95/30 days.

Please note, under the previous system all subscriptions were billed on the first day of each month, regardless of start date. After completion of the transfer process, subscriptions will now bill in 30-day periods based upon the date when a subscription was initiated. Subscriptions will continue to renew automatically and can be cancelled at any time. Please note that cancellations will now take effect at the end of your 30-day prepaid period.

* If an additional character slot is purchased during the middle of your prepaid period, the associated fee will be prorated based upon the number of days remaining in your prepaid period. At the end of the prepaid period, the additional character slot will be billed at the full rate.

Services that will use the PlayOnline ID after transfer:
-Friend List Plus
-LinkShell Community
-Community Site Link Registration Requests
-Player Event Support Requests

Services that will be temporarily unavailable:
-Character Reactivation Service
Please note that after the start of the transfer process, the Character Reactivation Service will be temporarily unavailable. We expect the service to resume in late August 2011. You will be required to transfer your PlayOnline account to a Square Enix ID before you can utilize this service.

Services that will end after transfer:
-Friend List Application
-PlayOnline Member Information (Web Version)

We will be posting responses to questions from users on the SQUARE ENIX Support Center Account Transfer FAQ which can be found here, so please take a look.

* Please visit the link above for information on how it will affect the customers who do not go through with the transfer.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding and cooperation.

title: A Reminder About Password Security
body:
This is an important reminder for customers with PlayOnline IDs or Square Enix accounts.

Your PlayOnline IDs, Square Enix accounts, and their passwords are sensitive pieces of information that should be guarded carefully. Wed like to ask that you take the following precautions to help prevent them from falling into the hands of a third party or otherwise being compromised:

* Do not use repeated strings of characters, phone numbers, birth dates, or other such information in your password.
* Change your password regularly.
* Do not use programs that put you at risk of viruses, spyware or other malware.
* Do not open emails or download files from unknown sources.
* Do not access suspicious websites.

Also please note that if you use the same account name or password as your PlayOnline ID or Square Enix account on other online services, a security breach at any of the other online services you use could potentially lead to your PlayOnline ID or Square Enix account being compromised as well. We therefore recommend that you use a different set of account names and passwords for each of your online services.

Another way to greatly decrease the likelihood of unauthorized access to your accounts is by using a Square Enix security token. We strongly recommend that you begin using one if you are not already doing so.

Please visit the following link for more information about security tokens.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Also, please note that FINAL FANTASY XIV features a system that allows for monitoring of suspicious account activity. Accounts that are suspected of having been compromised will have their access temporarily restricted.

In the event of a temporary login restriction being placed on a FINAL FANTASY XIV account, access to FINAL FANTASY XIV will be temporarily restricted and a Unauthorized connection to server detected message will be displayed when trying to log in. Access to FINAL FANTASY XI will also be restricted for all PlayOnline IDs linked to the Square Enix account in question.

Once login has been restricted, an email notification will be sent to the primary email address registered to the Square Enix account. This email will contain instructions on how to remove the login restriction. Players will be asked to reset their passwords and log in again.

Please visit the following link for more information about login restrictions.
http://support.na.square-enix.com/j/lbna

Thank you for helping us better safeguard your personal information and account information.

title: SQUARE ENIX ID and Password Security Measures
body:
Recently, a small number of customers have reported that their accounts have been compromised. While the users financial information was not at risk at any time, our investigation suggests unauthorized access followed a pattern which exploited the use of identical log-in information across multiple online services.

To maximize account security, we are advising all account holders to follow these best practices:
 Do not use the same log-in information for multiple online services.
 Do not use passwords that include readily identifiable information such as phone numbers or birth dates.
 Changing passwords regularly is highly recommended.
 Do not use unknown programs or visit suspicious websites that have the potential of spreading malware such as viruses and spyware.
 Do not open emails or attached files when you do not know who sent them.
 Conduct regular computer scans viruses, spyware and malware.

Use of a SQUARE ENIX Security Token with a SQUARE ENIX account can greatly diminish the likelihood of an account being compromised. We strongly recommend this strategy in helping to secure all SQUARE ENIX accounts.

More information about Security Tokens can be found at
http://account.square-enix.com/manual/en/about.html

Securing and safeguarding all SQUARE ENIX user accounts is our top priority.

title: Regarding Rise of Unauthorized Access and Password Security
body:
There has been an increase in the number of unauthorized access since November 15, 2011. The cause for this is still under investigation; however, it is possible that some of the victims may have been using the same account name and password from other online services with their Square Enix account.

Please note that if you use the same account name or password as your PlayOnline ID or Square Enix account on other online services, a security breach at any of the other online services you use could potentially lead to your PlayOnline ID or Square Enix account being compromised as well.

Likewise, if you use repeated strings of characters, phone numbers, birth dates, or other such information, this will leave your account highly vulnerable in the event another customer's account name and password is compromised from other online services, even if you are not using the same exact account name or password.

Therefore, if you are sharing the same account name or password between other online services and your Square Enix account, or if you are using information that can be easily deciphered, we ask that you change your password as soon as possible.

-Please visit the following link to reset your Square Enix password.
https://secure.square-enix.com/account/app/svc/reminder?

Also, please note that accounts that are suspected of having been compromised will have their access temporarily restricted. Once login has been restricted, an email notification will be sent to the primary email address registered to the Square Enix account. This email will contain instructions on how to remove the login restriction. Players will be asked to reset their passwords and log in again.

Please visit the following link for more information about login restrictions.
http://support.na.square-enix.com/j/lbna

If cases of unauthorized access continue to rise, we may be forced to take measures to reset Square Enix account passwords for all customers, so we kindly ask for your cooperation in helping us better safeguard your personal information and account information.

title: FINAL FANTASY XI Version Update (Dec. 22)
body:
At the following time, a version update was performed on FINAL FANTASY XI.

* Clients will update automatically upon launch after release of the patch.

[Date & Time]
Dec. 22, 2011 at 10:30 (PST)

[Affected Service]
- FINAL FANTASY XI

[Update Details]

The hint provided by the NPC regarding the quest item in A Prelude to Puissance has been modified.

The following adjustments were made to the quest Beyond Infinity:

- Players can still receive the Olde Rarab Tail after completing the quest.
- Players can enter the battlefield regardless of their level, if they have accepted the quest offer at least once.

Minor adjustments were made to the high definition fonts. (for Windows only)

The following issues have been addressed:

- An issue wherein players are unable to cancel the Grounds of Valor if they accept it in the following areas:
Lower Delkfutts Tower / Middle Delkfutts Tower / Upper Delkfutts Tower / Temple of Uggalepih / Den of Rancor / Sea Serpent Grotto / Quicksand Cave

- An issue wherein the daily limit for daily points obtained from trading rare items with the goblin in Gobbie Mystery Box will not reset at 12:00 a.m. (JST).

- An issue wherein the following monsters were bugged:
Ogre Bat at King Ranperrers Tomb / Prim Pika and Natty Gibbon at Dangruf Wadi / Thorn Bat and Fetor Bats at Outer Horutoto Ruins

- An issue wherein equipping a relic or mythic weapon, whose level requirement is 90 or above, as a sub-weapon will enable status effects that are not intended.

- An issue wherein using the beastmasters ability Ready will result in an unintended special ability to be activated.

- An issue wherein the incorrect icon is displayed for the following items:
Asura Samue +1 / Artful Belt +1

- An issue wherein the title Karkadann Exoculator is displayed incorrectly when it appears as an option when talking to the NPC Zuah Lepahnyu at Port Jeuno.

- An issue wherein the help is displayed incorrectly for Regen V.

- An issue wherein the item name for Twashtar is displayed incorrectly.

title: Attacking Monsters with an Avatar While Being AFK
body:
Recently, we have confirmed an issue wherein players in Grauberg (S) will leave their summoned avatars out while theyre AFK and let the avatars attack monsters by using the auto-counter attack system. Also, we have confirmed that these players have gained experience points and items through this act.

Not only does this act upset the game balance, it may interrupt the game play of other players. Any players caught performing the act by a Game Master (GM) may see disciplinary action taken against their accounts. Therefore, we ask that you please refrain yourself from performing this act.

Please be advised that a GM may request assistance from you if they determine that your actions may be causing a disruption in the game balance. If you received instructions from a GM, we ask that you follow them immediately. If you do not follow the instructions, as stated previously, the GM will take action against your account.

If you encounter a player performing this act, please do not hesitate to report them to the Special Task Force via the URL listed below. The Special Task Force and the GMs will work together to investigate the matter accordingly.

?SQUARE ENIX Support Center
http://support.na.square-enix.com/contacttop.php?id=20&la=1
[Report to Special Task Force]

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding in this matter.

title: About the HDD Space Required for the PlayStation 2 Version
body:
We would like to alert users of the PlayStation 2 version that the minimum hard disc space required will be increased from the current 10GB (or 8GB depending other factors) to 19GB in the Jun. 14, 2012 version update.

Customers who already have the appropriate space on their PlayStation 2 HDD will be able to update their game without issue. However, customers without the appropriate space will receive an error stating that there is not enough free space and the version update will not proceed. In this case, please secure the necessary space and try again.

Although the error message will tell you how much space you need, we would advise you to secure the appropriate space beforehand to make the version update process as smooth as possible.

For questions regarding the PlayStation HDD please visit the Sony Computer Entertainment knowledge base at www.us.playstation.com/support/.

Thank you for your continued support of FINAL FANTASY XI.

body:

- FINAL FANTASY XI

[Update Details]
The following changes have been made to Meeble Burrows:

- Additional measures have been implemented for the issue wherein a player may be ejected from the underground cave immediately after the start of a research expedition.
* We will continue to monitor the situation to ensure that similar issues do not occur.

- As a relief measure for the issue above, players will be reimbursed with the key item Moblin pheromone sack when they are ejected from the underground cave.
Additionally, in the event a party member is ejected immediately upon entry, the rest of the party members will be reimbursed with the key item Moblin pheromone sack as long as they leave the area within 3 minutes of the first player being ejected.

Excludes the following situations:
- Player fulfills at least one of the conditions and then uses the temporary item Hiatus Whistle or the temporary item Terminus Whistle.
- Player fulfills the appropriate conditions during a level 5 expedition (boss fight).
* If the player that was ejected is the party leader, the rest of the party members will immediately be ejected as well.

- If a party member is ejected during a level 5 expedition (boss fight), the corresponding boon given by their grimoire will now be removed.

title: Action against RMT Activity Involving Power Leveling
body:
We are currently investigating players who advertise power leveling services via Shout/Yell, collect gil from the participants, and then use that gil to engage in RMT-related activity. Our investigations thus far have revealed that these players regularly advertise in the Jeuno area and we have responded by terminating the FINAL FANTASY XI service accounts of those found guilty of this behavior.

Please be aware that advertising in such a manner in itself can be disrupting to other players and we may take action against players who continuously advertise for the above kind of parties. This also includes behavior that helps facilitate such activity. Please take caution in not supporting RMT-related activity.

In addition, if you witness other players engaging in this behavior, please report the details to the Special Task Force via the Square Enix Support Center.

Square Enix Support Center
http://support.na.square-enix.com/ffxi/
[Contact] > [Report to Special Task Force] > [Witnessed RMT related activity in-game]

We appreciate your understanding and cooperation in this matter.

title: Warning Regarding PlayOnline ID and Password Fraud
body:
It has come to our attention that certain individuals are attempting to direct players to a fake log-in page for the FINAL FANTASY XI Linkshell Community beta version in an attempt to steal (also known as phishing) their PlayOnline ID and password.

These scammers have been confirmed to send URLs via email with a message stating that a user agreement violation or billing issue has been confirmed.

If you have accidentally entered your PlayOnline ID and password into the fake website or simply clicked on the URL, you should run your anti-malware or anti-virus software and change your password immediately.

Also, we strongly recommend players to use a Square Enix Security Token which will vastly improve account security.

About the Square Enix Security Token
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Keep your personal information safe! Keep your PlayOnline ID, Square Enix ID, and passwords secure!

title: Windows XP Support Information
body:
We regret to inform you that Final Fantasy XI / PlayOnline will no longer support Windows XP in accordance with the following schedule.

Due to the fact that Microsoft(R) has already completed the support life cycle of this product, we have found that continuing support for this OS is a difficult proposition.

At the time support for this product ceases, the software you are currently using will continue to function and games will still be playable. We will also continue to perform regular updates of existing software. However, after the date when we discontinue support, we will as a general rule no longer be able to provide support for problems arising as a result of the operating system.

Furthermore, customer support for members utilizing this operating system will still be available through the Square Enix Support Center.

[Support End Date]
March 26th, 2013

[Affected Operating Systems]
Windows XP

Square Enix Support Center

title: Regarding the Inability to Access Seekers of Adoulin Areas
body:
The following issues have been confirmed.

- The Waypoints at Eastern and Western Adoulin are not recorded when a player warps to Ceizak Battlegrounds during the Seekers of Adoulin mission Onward to Adoulin.
- Recording an Enigmatic Device or Waypoint on the field and then moving out of the Adoulin area to an older area will prevent a player from warping back to the Adoulin area using a Waypoint.

We ask for your patience while we are undergoing testing to address the problem.

As a temporary workaround until a fix is implemented, please manually record at a Waypoint in either Eastern or Western Adoulin after you warp to Ceizak Battlegrounds.

In addition, if you experience the issue above and are no longer able to warp back to the Seekers of Adoulin area, please follow the steps below and place a GM call for assistance.

1) Select Help Desk from the main menu
2) Choose Help Desk as the issue category and then select I can't move my character or log out of the game. for the issue outline.
3) Select Other
*Please enter Unable to warp back to Adoulin due to bug as the subject when placing the GM call.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience this issue is causing and thank you for your patience.

* This issue was addressed during the maintenance that was conducted on Apr. 2, 2013 at 10:00 (PDT). In addition, players that were unable to warp back to the Adoulin areas should be now be able to warp as intended.

title: Please Safeguard your Software Tokens Emergency Removal PW
body:
We are currently receiving many contacts from customers who, after registering a Software Token, have become unable to log into their accounts due to the following reasons.

- The Square Enix Software Token app was accidentally deleted
*Even if the app is reinstalled, you will be unable to reconfigure the Software Token since this requires you to log into the Square Enix Account Management System.

- Smartphone was restored to factory settings

- Smartphone broke

- Switched to a new smartphone

If you are no longer able to log in due to any of the reasons above, you must use an Emergency Removal Password to remove the Software Token.

Therefore, please ensure that you write down your Emergency Removal Password and store it in a safe place. You can check your Emergency Removal Password by logging into the Square Enix Account Management System after registering a Software Token to your Square Enix account.

Square Enix Account Management System
https://secure.square-enix.com/account/

If you have become unable to log in and also lost your Emergency Removal Password, please refer to the FAQ below and contact the Support Center.
http://sqex.to/aYp

title: Warning Regarding Square Enix ID/Password Fraud
body:
It has come to our attention that certain individuals are attempting to direct players to a fake log-in page for the Square Enix Account Management System in an attempt to steal (also known as phishing) their Square Enix ID and password.

These scammers have been confirmed to send URLs via email with a message stating that a user agreement violation or billing issue has been confirmed.
The fake URLs are cleverly disguised by making minor alterations to the official URL such as removing the  (hyphen) symbol and switching the letter i with l. They can easily be mistaken for a legitimate URL, so please take special caution in noting any discrepancies.

The official URL for the Square Enix Account Management System is
https://secure.square-enix.com/account/

*The Square Enix Account Management System website complies with EV SSL certification. If you access a legitimate website, your browsers address bar will turn green and you will see SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. as the website administrator on the right or left hand side.

*For more information on EV SSL certification, please visit the website below.
https://www.symantec.com/page.jsp?id=how-ssl-works

If you have accidentally entered your Square Enix ID and password into the fake website or simply clicked on the false URL, you should run your anti-malware or anti-virus software and change your password immediately.

Changing your password
http://sqex.to/gr8

Also, we strongly recommend players to use a Square Enix Security Token which will vastly improve account security.

About the Square Enix Security Token
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Keep your personal information safe! Keep your Square Enix ID and password secure!

title: [Repost] Action against RMT Activity Involving Power Levelin
body:
We are currently investigating players who advertise power leveling services via Shout/Yell, collect gil from the participants, and then use that gil to engage in RMT-related activity. Our investigations thus far have revealed that these players regularly advertise in the Jeuno area and we have responded by terminating the FINAL FANTASY XI service accounts of those found guilty of this behavior.

Please be aware that advertising in such a manner in itself can be disrupting to other players and we may take action against players who continuously advertise for the above kind of parties. title: Mog Satchel now Available with the Software Token
body:
As of May 13, 2013, players using the Square Enix Software Token (Software Token) will also receive the Mog Satchel.

Registering a Software Token to your Square Enix account will allow both existing and newly created characters on that account to receive the Mog Satchel. Players who already have a Software Token registered will receive the Mog Satchel immediately.

However, please note that an account will not be eligible to receive the Mog Satchel if a Software Token was initially registered to it but is currently removed. In such a case, please register another Software Token to receive the Mog Satchel. In addition, characters who have already received the Mog Satchel on a Square Enix account that has a Square Enix Security Token (Security Token) registered to it will be able to continue using the item even after the Software Token is removed.

*The specs for the Mog Satchel are the same for the Security Token and Software Token. Removing the Security Token and registering a Software Token in its place will not enable the use of multiple Mog Satchels and the number of storable items will not increase either.

title: Warning Regarding Square Enix ID/Password Fraud
body:
Previously, we announced that certain individuals were attempting to direct players to a fake log-in page for the Square Enix Account Management System in an attempt to steal (also known as phishing) their Square Enix ID and password. It has now come to our attention that the contents of the fake websites and fake emails are being ever more cleverly disguised.

In order to keep your personal information and game data safe, we urge you to exercise caution to avoid these emails and websites. 

[Characteristics of the fake websites]

- The s is missing from https in the URL of the login page
The fake website will display http:// in the URL

- The hyphen symbol is missing from square-enix
The fake website will display squareenix in the URL

- The letter I is replaced with either l or j
The fake website will display square-enlx or square-enjx

- The com in square-enix.com is replaced by various domains

* There is a possibility that these same scammers will continue to change their methods in their attempt to steal personal information. The above characteristics are examples we have confirmed.

[Characteristics of fake emails]

- The email will contain a message stating that a user agreement violation, suspicious activity, or billing issue has been confirmed and will ask the recipient to go to the fake website.
* A legitimate email from Square Enix may contain the same content, as the scammers copy and paste the text from our emails in most cases.

- The fake URL is hyperlinked to the body text
* The email will contain the official URL for the Square Enix Account Management System (https://secure.square-enix.com/account/) in the body text, but it is actually hyperlinked to the fake website.
* This disguise can be especially easy to miss, so please be very careful.

- The senders disguise themselves by using an official email address
* The scammers have been confirmed to use our official email address like the one below.
mailto:autoinfo_na@account.square-enix.com

In some cases, the sender will assume the identity of the Square Enix Account Management System or Square Enix MEMBERS representative and use the Japanese names for these services.

* There is a possibility that these same scammers will continue to change their methods in their attempt to steal personal information. The above characteristics are examples we have confirmed.

[How to detect a fake website]

Before you access the website:
- If you need to click on a link included in an email or website, please confirm that the URL is legitimate.
* The official URL for the Square Enix Account Management System is https://secure.square-enix.com/account/

- Check that the link displayed is not hyperlinked to a fake URL
* Mouse over the link in your internet browser or email program to display the URL contained in the link and confirm that it is legitimate.

If you already accessed the website:
- Confirm that the website is legitimate

*The Square Enix Account Management System website complies with EV SSL certification. If you access a legitimate website, your browsers address bar will turn green and you will see SQUARE ENIX CO., LTD. as the website administrator on the right or left hand side.

*For more information on EV SSL certification, please visit the website below.
https://www.symantec.com/page.jsp?id=how-ssl-works

If you have accidentally entered your Square Enix ID and password into the fake website or simply clicked on the false URL, you should run your anti-malware or anti-virus software and change your password immediately.

Changing your password
http://sqex.to/gr8

Also, we strongly recommend players to use a Square Enix Security Token which will vastly improve account security.

About the Square Enix Security Token
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Keep your personal information safe! Keep your Square Enix ID and password secure!

We have confirmed the following issue as of Aug. 8, 2013. Investigation and recovery work is currently underway. We ask for your patience in this matter until the issue is addressed.

[Issue Details]
- An issue wherein if a player uses the text command /localsettings hidearmor on, the feet graphics of other PCs does not change to the starter armor as intended (PlayStation 2 only).

* While we were originally planning to implement the feature where the other PCs equipment graphic changes to the starter gear (instead of having nothing equipped) in the future, the feature was prematurely released during the version update on Aug. 7.

Instead of changing the feet graphics of other PCs to the starter armor, we have confirmed that the feet graphics currently changes into something random. Additionally, this issue is causing the processing speed of the client to slow down.

We are currently working as fast as we can to address this issue. We ask for your patience in this matter until the issue is addressed.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.

* The issue was addressed during the emergency maintenance that was conducted on Aug. 8, 2013 at 10:00 (PDT).

title: Regarding the Price Change of the Square Enix Security Token
body:
We would like to take this opportunity to announce the price increase of the Square Enix Security Token as of Sep. 1, 2013.

Up until this point, we focused heavily on keeping the cost down despite increased production costs and the cost of implementing counter measures against security breaches. However, we came to a conclusion that it is no longer possible to maintain the existing price of the Square Enix Token.

Therefore, in order for us to sustain the security level that we have been offering, we will need to slightly increase the price of the Square Enix Security Token.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your understanding.

Please note that we also offer the Square Enix Software Token app for iOS and Android free of charge.

* Please visit the following URL for more information on the Square Enix Security Token and the Square Enix Software Token app.
http://www.square-enix.com/na/account/otp/

Details on the Price Change:
Before: $9.99 / 999 Crysta
After: $10.99 / 1,099 Crysta

Date:
Any orders placed after Sep. 1, 2013

*On Aug. 29, 2013 around 1:00 a.m., we have revised the prices due to the incorrect Crysta prices that were displayed incorrectly.

title: Current Known Issues for the Recent Version Update (Nov. 6)
body:
As of the recent version update which occurred on Nov. 4, 2013, we have identified the issues listed below. The issues are being addressed, and new updates will follow as additional information becomes available.

[Current Known Issues]

- When progressing though certain events, there were cases where the screen freezes and unable to progress in Mog Garden.

title: Issues with Exiting Mog Gardens (Dec. 10)
body:
We are currently receiving contacts from players, who do not have the Seekers of Adoulin expansion installed on their clients, reporting that they are unable to exit a mog garden once they enter one.

The issue is under investigation; however, we ask that you do not enter a mog garden if you do not have the Seekers of Adoulin expansion installed on your client until further update.

In addition, if you encounter the aforementioned issue and become stuck, please contact a GM for assistance.

You can make a GM call by following the steps below:

1. Select Help Desk from the Main Menu
2. Choose Help Desk as the issue category and then select I cant move my character or log out of the game for the issue outline
3. Select Other
* Please enter Unable to move out of mog garden as the subject when placing the GM call.

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience this issue is causing and thank you for your patience.

* The above issue has been addressed in the Version Update that occurred on Dec. 11, 2013 00:00 (PST). Please note, players that were affected by this issue between Dec. 10, 2013 10:30 to Dec. 11, 2013 00:00 (PST) will still need to place a GM support call for assistance with their character. We apologize for the inconvenience.

body:

Please note that for the duration until recovery, we have set up a temporary phone support line for any urgent concerns you may have.

?Temporary Phone Support Line
Tel:  310-846-0345
Business Hours:  9:00 a.m. - 6:00 p.m.

*This temporary phone support line will be available even on Saturdays, Sundays, and holidays until current technical difficulties have been resolved.

*Because we anticipate a high volume of calls on this temporary phone support line, for any non-urgent matters we ask that you please wait and instead contact us through the Support Center once full recovery has been achieved.

In addition, investigations have revealed that we are not able to receive the following types of inquiries at this time:

- Replies to mails previously sent by the Support Center

title: All Worlds Maintenance (May 14)
body:
At the following time, we will be performing server maintenance to accompany the version update. During this period, FINAL FANTASY XI will be unavailable.

In addition, our server equipment will undergo maintenance at this time. Please note that the all Worlds maintenance will take longer than usual as a result.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and thank you for your patience.

* This maintenance will be accompanied by a version update. After maintenance is complete, the update will automatically begin after you press the "Play" button. After that, please follow the instructions on the screen.

* The World Transfer Service will be unavailable starting 30 minutes before the maintenance. Please wait until after the maintenance is completed before attempting to use this service.

* You may receive errors such as "POL-1160" or "POL-0010" during the download process due to heavy server traffic. If you are unable to access the update, we ask that you please wait a while and then try again.

Thank you for your cooperation and understanding in making this a smooth version update.

body:

?Regarding the Arrapago Remnants, the number of occurring instances has been limited, and the number of members that may enter is now 1 character/party/alliance per minute.
